psychological_meaning: Kokoda represents stability, practicality, and groundedness. This muted, earthy tone evokes feelings of calm and reliability. It suggests maturity and a connection to nature, often associated with comfort and endurance. While not particularly vibrant, Kokoda can offer a sense of reassurance and understated elegance.
